QuestInfo.name: Ueriba's Endless Challenge
QuestInfo.0: It seems Ueriba in Showa Town is having trouble with his hair. You should help him out.
QuestInfo.1:
Ueriba is a stylish guy who can always be found fussing over his appearance. He's always trying new products, and now he's after the pomade used by bigshots and lieutenants in the Yakuza. It won't be an easy task, but you've agreed to get your hands on the #b#t04000094#k for Ueriba.


#t4000094#   #b#c4000094##k/30
QuestInfo.2: Ueriba was grateful you retrieved the pomade for him. The question remains whether he'll actually get any use out of it.

0.0: I was hoping you could help me with a dilemma. I'm supposed to be going out tonight, but I can't decide how to style my hair. As a stylish guy, having an iconic hairstyle is crucial.
0.1: My house is overflowing with all sorts of hair products. From creams to waxes to mousse and gels of varying firmness.
0.2: But there's one thing that eludes my collection. Pomade. It's crucial for that glossy shine, and I want it.
0.3: There are rumors that the pomade used by Yakuza bigshots is a special, custom-made product. I want \r\n#b#t04000094##k, and I won't settle for a lesser product. If you bring me the #b#t04000094##k, I'll reward you handsomely. So, what do you say?

yes.0: You've made the right choice! When you're this serious about your hair, it's not uncommon to go through a full bottle of product in a single day. I'm going to need enough pomade to last the full month. Could you please bring me #b#t04000094##k x30?

no.0: Don't you want me to have the stylish hair I deserve?

1.1: Wow! You got all 30 of them!
1.2: I think I'll try it right now! A-amazing! It goes on so smooth I could do anything with my hair, even slick it back like this. And it's so glossy! It really makes my hair color pop!\n\n Hahaha. You're staring. My hair's looking pretty stylish, right? All right, I'm satisfied. Here's your reward, you've earned it.

item.0: This isn't going to be enough to last me a whole month. Get me #b#t04000094##k x30.
